## 보관 원문

> # SSAB Luleå schedule change
>
> SSAB postponed planned start-up of the new Luleå steel mill by twelve months, from
> the end of 2028 to the end of 2029. The stated cause was delay to transmission-grid
> reinforcement. SSAB said the revised schedule did not change the communicated
> €4.5 billion investment framework.
